title: PolarsTable parity
description: About 120 pipelines run on phibble's in-memory DataFrame and on its Polars backend, PolarsTable, which must give the same columns, types, groups, and rows.
tolerance: Floating-point values within 1e-9 relative; all other values equal.
note: n_compared counts the assertions in each test. Errors are over floating-point comparisons; other values must be equal.
